Package com.javiergs.cortex4j

Class CortexClient

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.cortex4j.CortexClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, WebSocket.Listener
public final class CortexClient extends Object implements WebSocket.Listener, AutoCloseable
Minimal asynchronous JSON-RPC 2.0 transport for EMOTIV Cortex. Secure connections use Java's configured trust. Explicit local fallback may skip certificate verification for loopback connections only.
Version:
1.0 (2026-10-29)

      public static CompletableFuture<CortexClient> connectWithLocalFallback()
